items.summary: A six-scene "Supplier Retention Command Center" Data App for the #DataAppChallenge: headline numbers, churn hot spots, why suppliers leave (first 14 days predict the next 16), an at-risk worklist, a supplier-facing view and a what-if simulator, on live governed data. 8 reactions, 1 repost.

items.author: Andrew Hill, Distinguished Solutions Engineer at Tableau, Nov 18
items.summary: Argues the real Data Apps value is a backend that triggers workflows in Slack, Jira and Salesforce, not more 3D globes; he's prototyping auth and API brokering for Data Apps and expects BI roles to absorb more systems integration. 16 reactions, 1 comment.

items.summary: Built the same "NSW Road Harm Observatory" app two ways, Claude + Tableau plugin/MCP and Tableau Studio, both running as Tableau Cloud Data Apps (See, Understand, Change slider, Deliver action brief; synthetic data).
